column1: # Stonesense local display and local Console output translations.
# All message and format literals below occur in the installed DLL; source identifies their human-visible use.
# Only fixed prose is translated. KEY/action tokens, API names, enums, raw game reports/names, paths, and numeric values remain original.
# No rules target remote output, exported files, Stonesense.log, benchmark data, or screenshot image content.
# Floating-point values use {s}; {d} is a signed integer. Adjacent optional strings in native formats are captured as one combined value.
# main.cpp: welcome, credits, and startup. Contributor name-only lines deliberately have no entries.
